night3_start.name: {name}
night3_start.text: *I’m back in my room. It was a heavy day.*

night3_faithful_msg_seo_1.name: Seoyeon
night3_faithful_msg_seo_1.text: What you saw today, that’s a secret

night3_faithful_msg_seo_3.name: {name}
night3_faithful_msg_seo_3.text: *‘You can come again.’ — For her, that’s the same as saying ‘please come.’*

night3_faithful_msg_yuna_1.name: {name}
night3_faithful_msg_yuna_1.text: *Yuna sent a photo of a note. A single line written in her notebook.*

night3_faithful_msg_yuna_2.name: Yuna
night3_faithful_msg_yuna_2.text: That novel, I still haven’t decided on the ending

night3_faithful_msg_dain_1.name: Dain
night3_faithful_msg_dain_1.text: If you’re gonna ask about my ankle, come ask in person lol

night3_faithful_msg_dain_3.name: {name}
night3_faithful_msg_dain_3.text: *Masked with ‘haha’ — but the sincerity bleeds through.*

night3_dream_1.name: {name}
night3_dream_1.text: *I had a dream. — I was walking side by side with someone.*

night3_dream_2.name: {name}
night3_dream_2.text: *Couldn't see their face, but strangely, I wasn't anxious.*

night3_cheat_msg_1.name: {name}
night3_cheat_msg_1.text: *I’m back in my room. It was a heavy day. I look at my phone.*

night3_cheat_msg_2.name: Seoyeon
night3_cheat_msg_2.text: Only be that way with me

night3_cheat_msg_5.name: Yuna
night3_cheat_msg_5.text: *...I'm okay. Just go with what you won't regret.*

night3_cheat_msg_dain_1.name: Dain
night3_cheat_msg_dain_1.text: ...lol I wish this were a joke

night3_cheat_msg_7.name: {name}
night3_cheat_msg_7.text: *Yuna sent three messages. From someone who normally doesn’t even send one. — That’s how angry she is.*

night3_nightmare_2.name: {name}
night3_nightmare_2.text: *I’m standing in darkness. I can’t see anything.*

night3_nightmare_3.name: Seoyeon
night3_nightmare_3.text: You only did that with me...

night3_nightmare_4.name: Yuna
night3_nightmare_4.text: I told you not to lie.

night3_nightmare_5.name: Dain
night3_nightmare_5.text: You said you’d come. I was waiting.

night3_nightmare_6.name: {name}
night3_nightmare_6.text: *I see hands from three directions. Faintly, in the darkness.*

night3_nightmare_seo.name: {name}
night3_nightmare_seo.text: *I reached toward Seoyeon. The moment I saw that smile — she vanished.*

night3_nightmare_yuna.name: {name}
night3_nightmare_yuna.text: *I stepped toward Yuna. Just as my fingertips were about to touch — she vanished.*

night3_nightmare_dain.name: {name}
night3_nightmare_dain.text: *I ran toward Dain. The moment I thought I had her — she vanished.*

night3_nightmare_end.name: {name}
night3_nightmare_end.text: *I reached out. — I can’t grasp it.*

night3_nightmare_end_3.name: {name}
night3_nightmare_end_3.text: *— I woke up drenched in sweat. 3 AM. I see the ceiling.*

night3_cheat_reflect_1.name: {name}
night3_cheat_reflect_1.text: *I pulled out my phone. Gallery. Scrolling again. — Sojeong's photo.*

night3_cheat_reflect_2.name: {name}
night3_cheat_reflect_2.text: *She's smiling. Smiling at me in the group photo. Without knowing a thing.*

night3_cheat_reflect_3.name: {name}
night3_cheat_reflect_3.text: *This time, I tried to say it without regrets. That I'd live honestly at this school.*

night3_cheat_reflect_5.name: {name}
night3_cheat_reflect_5.text: *— I won't run. This time, just one person.*

night3_faithful_reflect_1.name: {name}
night3_faithful_reflect_1.text: *I opened my eyes. Morning light seeps through the curtains. — Today's dream was a good one.*

night3_faithful_reflect_2.name: {name}
night3_faithful_reflect_2.text: *I pulled out my phone. Opened the gallery. Sojeong's photo. — I stopped scrolling, and held down.*

night3_faithful_reflect_3.name: {name}
night3_faithful_reflect_3.text: *I kept it because deleting it felt like erasing those feelings too. But now it's not lingering attachment — it's just a record. — Its purpose is done.*

night3_faithful_reflect_4.name: {name}
night3_faithful_reflect_4.text: *This time is different. I'll speak to only one person. The rest — I'll be clear with them.*

night3_faithful_msg_yuna_2_ins.name: {name}
night3_faithful_msg_yuna_2_ins.text: *Because writing the ending means it's over. — Yuna is afraid of this story ending.*

night3_cheat_msg_3_ins.name: {name}
night3_cheat_msg_3_ins.text: *Seoyeon uses the word 'please.' — That word doesn't exist in her vocabulary. That's how far she's crumbled.*

night3_cheat_msg_4_ins.name: Yuna
night3_cheat_msg_4_ins.text: *Who you'll stand beside. I want you to understand the weight of that.*

night3_dream_2_ins.name: {name}
night3_dream_2_ins.text: *This time, I wanted to say it without regrets. I told myself I'd live honestly at this school.*

night3_cheat_reflect_3_ins.name: {name}
night3_cheat_reflect_3_ins.text: *The exact opposite of what happened with Sojeong, but the result is the same. Someone gets hurt.*

night3_cheat_reflect_3_ins3.name: {name}
night3_cheat_reflect_3_ins3.text: *This school: regret from saying too much.*

night3_cheat_reflect_3_ins4.name: {name}
night3_cheat_reflect_3_ins4.text: *In the end, the problem was never 'to say or not to say' — it was 'to whom.'*

night3_cheat_reflect_3_ins5.name: {name}
night3_cheat_reflect_3_ins5.text: *Minsu said it. 'Saying no is also love.'*

night3_cheat_reflect_3_ins6.name: {name}
night3_cheat_reflect_3_ins6.text: *Seoyeon said, 'I'm not just one of many.'*

night3_cheat_reflect_5_ins.name: {name}
night3_cheat_reflect_5_ins.text: *I had a dream. — Walking side by side with someone. Couldn't see their face, but strangely, I wasn't anxious.*

night3_faithful_reflect_2_ins4.name: {name}
night3_faithful_reflect_2_ins4.text: *One second. My finger stops. — Minsu's words come back to me. 'Saying no is also love.'*

night3_faithful_reflect_2_ins5.name: {name}
night3_faithful_reflect_2_ins5.text: *...Right. I need to start by saying no to my own past.*

night3_faithful_reflect_3_ins.name: {name}
night3_faithful_reflect_3_ins.text: *Minsu said it. 'Saying no is also love.' He's right. At my old school, Sojeong never even got the chance to reject me. Because I kept my mouth shut. — That was the cruelest ending for both of us.*

night3_faithful_reflect_4_ins.name: {name}
night3_faithful_reflect_4_ins.text: *The gallery is empty. The space where Sojeong's photo was. The blank screen feels even more distinct.*

night3_faithful_reflect_4_ins2.name: {name}
night3_faithful_reflect_4_ins2.text: *Deleting the photo was easy. Just one finger, and it's done. — Feelings take much longer.*

night3_faithful_reflect_4_ins3.name: {name}
night3_faithful_reflect_4_ins3.text: *Still. At least for what I've deleted — I can move forward.*

night3_faithful_reflect_4_ins6.name: {name}
night3_faithful_reflect_4_ins6.text: *I closed my phone. The gallery is empty, and my mind is still a mess. — Still, one step forward.*

night3_dream_seo_bonus.name: {name}
night3_dream_seo_bonus.text: *When I close my eyes, the feeling of walking beside Seoyeon still lingers.*

night3_dream_yuna_bonus.name: {name}
night3_dream_yuna_bonus.text: *When I close my eyes, the quiet air beside Yuna still lingers.*

night3_dream_dain_bonus.name: {name}
night3_dream_dain_bonus.text: *When I close my eyes, Dain's laughter comes back to me a beat later.*
